# Nastaliq

> Nastaliq LLP builds and hosts cloud ERP for growing businesses in North America: inventory, purchasing, sales and accounting in one private system, in English and French. Cloud only. Pricing is a flat monthly subscription with unlimited users plus a one-time setup fee, sent by email.

Nastaliq LLP is incorporated with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) and based in Lahore, Pakistan. Contact: hello@nastaliq.co

French version: https://nastaliq.co/fr/llms.txt

## Products and status
- [Business suite](https://nastaliq.co/products#suite): Inventory, purchasing, accounting and sales in one cloud system, set up for your business and hosted by us. (Available)
- [Janitorial operations](https://nastaliq.co/products#janitorial): Run a commercial cleaning company from one app, for cleaners, supervisors and clients. (Early access)
- [Owner dashboard and alerts](https://nastaliq.co/products#owner): A home screen by role, phone-friendly stock screens, and a morning email digest of what needs attention. (Early access)
- [English and French](https://nastaliq.co/products#bilingual): One switch on every screen, with Canadian French terms such as courriel and téléverser. (Available)
- [Point of sale](https://nastaliq.co/products#pos): A clean, fast till for restaurants, fast food and bakeries. (In development)

## Industries
- [ERP for distribution and wholesale companies](https://nastaliq.co/industries/distribution): Purchasing, receiving, stock and customer pricing in one private cloud system, set up from a distribution preset and hosted by us. (Available)
- [ERP for retail businesses](https://nastaliq.co/industries/retail): Stock, purchasing, sales records and accounting in one private cloud system, set up from a retail preset and hosted by us. (Available)
- [Operations software for commercial cleaning companies](https://nastaliq.co/industries/janitorial): Crews, inspections, clients and supplies in one app, for cleaners, supervisors and the companies you serve. Now in early access. (Early access)

- [Shared SaaS, private cloud or on-premise: where should your ERP live?](https://nastaliq.co/articles/private-cloud-erp-vs-saas-vs-on-premise): A plain comparison of the three ways to host an ERP, and what each one means for control of your operations data, upkeep and cost.

## Frequently asked questions
**What is Nastaliq?** Nastaliq is a cloud ERP for growing businesses in North America, typically companies with $1M or more in annual revenue. It puts inventory, purchasing, sales and accounting in one system, on your own private instance, in English and French. We set it up for your business and host it.

**How much does Nastaliq cost?** Pricing is a flat monthly subscription with unlimited users, plus a one-time setup fee. We send the exact plan and price by email after you tell us what you run.

**How long does it take to go live?** Most businesses go live in about six weeks, with setup and hosting handled by us.

**Do I need to install anything?** No. Nastaliq runs in the cloud. You sign in from a browser or your phone.

**Is Nastaliq available in French?** Yes. Every screen has an English and French switch, with Canadian French terms such as courriel and téléverser.

**Can you bring my existing records in?** Yes. We help bring your existing customers, products and records in during setup. Tell us what you use today and we will say what is possible.

**Who builds and supports Nastaliq?** Nastaliq LLP, a small team in Lahore, Pakistan, serving clients in North America.
